I liked to learn. Memorizing things made me feel good. I just felt so out of place because kids my age and my skin color usually don’t like those things. Once I got to middle school I started to try and open myself up more.

It hit me hard again in my senior year, but thanks to having learned a little bit about mental health in a psychology course I took at THE Southern University and A&M College in Baton Rouge, LA, soon after graduation I decided to finally ask for help.

I would go on to have another depression stint in my senior year of high school. I still hadn’t learned about what had been crippling me. I then went off to college and had off and on bouts with depression.
